title: Al-Risala
author: ibn-abi-zayd-al-qayrawani
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Ibn Abi Zayd's short primer on what a Muslim must believe and practise, beginning with the creed and then setting out purification, prayer, alms, fasting, pilgrimage, marriage, trade and the ordinary duties of daily life. Its brevity made it the first Maliki text taught to children across North and West Africa.
historicalContext: Written in Qayrawan in the tenth century, the Risala condensed the Maliki teaching of the region into a text that could be memorised. It circulated with commentaries and glosses and remains part of the standard curriculum in Maliki schools.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
